assignedToId.description: User ID to assign every created task to

notes.description: Additional notes — applied to every created task

groupId.description: Shared group (family) ID of every created task

tasks.description: All created tasks (parents; semipreparate tasks are nested as subtasks)

assignedToId.description: User ID to assign the task to

locationId.description: Production location — stock is reserved/consumed here.

recipeId.description: Byproduct recipe id — must be an active byproduct (isByproduct) of the produced recipe (or of one of the task's subtask recipes).

quantity.description: Quantity actually left over, in the byproduct recipe's own unit. 0 = none.

reason.description: Reason for the transition (required for cancellation)

actualYield.description: Actual yield produced (required when status is FINALIZAT)

outputLocationId.description: Destination location for the finished goods (FINALIZAT). Defaults to the production location; if different, a transfer (foaie de drum) is generated.

byproducts.description: Actual byproduct quantities left over (FINALIZAT only). When SENT, it is authoritative: exactly the listed quantities are credited to stock at the production location (byproducts not listed get nothing). When OMITTED, the legacy fallback credits each declared byproduct with yieldQuantity × scaleFactor.

fulfillmentType.description: Fulfillment type: DELIVERY (driver) or PICKUP (customer collects)

archived.description: true → archive the order, false → restore it to the active list

category.description: Product category of the material (null = Misc)

expiryDate.description: Earliest expiry of the batches in stock (null = untracked)

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary location for the user

recipeId.description: Recipe ID — finished good / semipreparat (XOR with rawMaterialId)

unit.description: Ignored — the server uses the material's stock unit.

toLocationId.description: Destination location ID (UUID). XOR with destinationName — omit for an ad-hoc destination.

destinationName.description: Ad-hoc destination name (e.g. an event) — goods leave the system on completion. XOR with toLocationId.

destinationContact.description: Recipient (person) at the destination — printed on the aviz.

assignedToId.description: User who carries out the transport (UUID)

delegateIdCard.description: Delegate ID card (serie + numar) — printed on the aviz

rawMaterialId.description: Raw material ID (null for recipe items)

rawMaterialTitle.description: Item title (raw material or recipe name)

toLocation.description: Destination location. For ad-hoc destinations (adhocDestination=true) this is synthesized from the free-text name/address with an empty id.

adhocDestination.description: True when the destination is a one-off (event) address, not a saved location — goods leave the system on completion.

destinationContact.description: Recipient (person) at the destination — printed on the aviz.

receiverName.description: Name of the person who received the goods

hasReceiverSignature.description: Whether a receipt signature image is stored

assignedToId.description: Transport person (UUID). Required to move a transfer into IN_TRANZIT.

reservedCount.description: Number of pieces reserved for recipes

nutrition.description: Nutrition per 100g/100ml: {calories, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturatedFat, fiber, salt}

quantityPerPiece.description: Quantity per piece (e.g. 1.5 kg per bag)
